# Calendar

A month grid for picking a date or a range.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-calendar--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:brand-expressive;mode:light" title="Calendar examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-calendar--docs">Open Calendar in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-calendar--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:brand-expressive;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** Inside a popover on an event site, when visitors pick a date near today. Not always shown in a section.

- **Use it when:** Dates near today, ranges, or when the day of the week matters.
- **Not when:** A date people know by heart, such as a birth date: typed fields are faster.

Instead:

- [Date picker](./date-picker.md): A calendar opened from a field, in a popover.
- [Input](./input.md): A known date typed in.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Arrow keys move between days; Page Up and Page Down change month. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is a grid; the selected and today's dates are announced. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add calendar
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Calendar reads 31 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Calendar's tokens to change Calendar alone.
